visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tariff/plan comparison cards with optional flag badge, tagline, plan name, feature checklist, price, compare link and calculate button
visualCharacteristics.layout: Equal-height cards in a responsive grid; price and actions pinned to the card bottom

contentPattern.structure: one row per tariff card; optional first cell with a short flag text (e.g. Bestseller); body cell: tagline paragraph, plan-name heading, feature list, price paragraph (e.g. z.B. 1,85 € mtl.), optional compare link paragraph, calculate button link last

reuseGuidance: Use for side-by-side tariff or plan tiers with features, price and a calculate CTA. Colour differences (grey, cyan-grey, ...) and layout tweaks (alt, alt-2, alt-3) are option classes; do not fork a new block. Plain feature/benefit cards without price belong in benefits.
